params.prompt: Use the exact art style and finish of the first reference image. The student is the character of the second reference and the cat is the one of the third. Cinematic establishing illustration for a game loading screen, wide shot: the surface of the Moon at night, lit by soft blue earthlight. A gray regolith plain with small craters and scattered rocks, long soft deep-blue shadows that are never pure black, a trail of bootprints and tiny paw prints, a small cardboard box with a hand-drawn crescent moon on its side resting on the ground like a tiny capsule, one small glowing cyan beacon in the middle distance, and far away the small silhouette of a generic gold-and-gray lunar descent stage with four legs and no markings. The student, wearing a small original soft spacesuit with a clear bubble helmet, and the cat, with a tiny bubble helmet, hop across the plain in low gravity, small in the frame. A big blue half-lit Earth hangs high in a black sky with a few stars. No flags, no insignia, no patches, no logos, no letters anywhere. The lower fifth of the image is calmer and darker so interface text can sit on it. Art style: stylized low-poly 3D exactly like the reference images, crisp faceted flat-shaded planes with a hand-painted gradient on each facet, cel-shaded lighting with a bright rim light, chunky simplified forms, clean readable silhouettes, matte materials, palette of cream, terracotta, tropical green, petrol blue and warm wood browns, with cyan reserved for technology, data and collectibles. No text, no logos, no interface.
